question: Should this protected draft policy-doctor stack wait for lower-stack resolution plus docs and real behavior proof before merge consideration?
rationale: The PR has a protected maintainer label and changes compatibility/security-boundary-adjacent policy repair behavior, so automation should not treat a narrow docs fix as sufficient merge authority.

options.title: Wait for docs, proof, and restack
options.body: Require the contributor to document the review-required previews, add redacted terminal/live doctor --fix proof for the new agent/tool slice, and restack after the lower policy PR lands or is replaced.

options.title: Accept the protected stack risk
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the current stacked diff and missing top-slice proof, but that would leave operator-facing repair semantics under-documented.

options.title: Pause this top slice
options.body: Keep the PR draft or close it if the lower preview work changes direction and the agent/tool preview slice should be resubmitted later.

recommendation.title: Wait for docs, proof, and restack
recommendation.body: Require the contributor to document the review-required previews, add redacted terminal/live doctor --fix proof for the new agent/tool slice, and restack after the lower policy PR lands or is replaced.
